NAME:
   probe - urfave/cli v2 probe

USAGE:
   probe [global options] command [command options]

COMMANDS:
   help, h  Shows a list of commands or help for one command

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --force, -f               skip confirmation prompts (default: false)
   --limit value, -n value   maximum number of results to return, a deliberately long description (default: 0)
   --dry-run                 print what would change (default: false)
   --output FILE, -o FILE    write output to FILE
   --print-config-dir, --cd  multi-letter alias (default: false)
   --help, -h                show help
